mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id, period_year, period_month, manhours, accident_count, lost_time_count, fatality_count, trir, ltir, budget_planned, budget_used, fcm_project_code, vbp_project_code, reported_by, comment, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_safety_performance_land WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT sp.id, sp.department_id, d.name AS department_name, sp.period_year, sp.period_month, sp.manhours, sp.accident_count, sp.lost_time_count, sp.fatality_count, sp.trir, sp.ltir, sp.budget_planned, sp.budget_used, sp.fcm_project_code, sp.vbp_project_code, sp.reported_by, ru.name AS reporter_name, sp.comment, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at FROM tb_safety_performance_land sp LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.id = sp.department_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = sp.reported_by AND ru.deleted = 0
ORDER BY sp.period_year DESC, sp.period_month DESC, sp.department_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_performance_land ( department_id, period_year, period_month, manhours, accident_count, lost_time_count, fatality_count, trir, ltir, budget_planned, budget_used, fcm_project_code, vbp_project_code, reported_by, comment, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{periodYear}, #{periodMonth}, #{manhours}, #{accidentCount}, #{lostTimeCount}, #{fatalityCount}, #{trir}, #{ltir}, #{budgetPlanned}, #{budgetUsed}, #{fcmProjectCode}, #{vbpProjectCode}, #{reportedBy}, #{comment}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_safety_performance_land SET manhours = #{manhours}, accident_count = #{accidentCount}, lost_time_count = #{lostTimeCount}, fatality_count = #{fatalityCount}, trir = #{trir}, ltir = #{ltir}, budget_planned = #{budgetPlanned}, budget_used = #{budgetUsed}, fcm_project_code = #{fcmProjectCode}, vbp_project_code = #{vbpProjectCode}, reported_by = #{reportedBy}, comment = #{comment}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_safety_performance_land SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
